entry.summary: AWS has expanded its Customer Carbon Footprint Tool (CCFT) to include Scope 3 emissions data alongside updated Scope 1 and 2 emissions, giving customers more insight into their carbon impact. AWS customers can access this information and track changes over time through the AWS Billing console.
